messages:
Asha - MKTG: Quick design ask for next week's Serving Wins launch: hero for landing, single slide with benchmark sparkline, compact inbound routing diagram for ops, and three micro-explainers (cost, latency, quality). Need first drafts by Tue noon.

Noah (Design): Landing hero first. Prefer hybrid schematic + illustration. Will mock mobile-first so we can crop for social.

Priya - Creative Ops: Starter Figma file uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/serve-wins-kit. Use component set serve/win-tiles-v1. I added localization keys and export tokens.

Kira - Brand: Use stacked logo mark. No shadows. Contrast >=4.5:1 for small type. Approved palette only. Static SVG for slide; short MP4 for social.

Diego PMM: Micro-explainers: dev (tokens/sec + latency), enterprise (SLA + private deploy), finance (cost/unit + batching note). CTAs: "Try demo" / "Contact sales". I'll drop 1-line copy by 15:30.

Noah (Design): Draft export spec: hero 1400x800 (svg + 72dpi png), microtile 560x560, slide 1920x1080 (pptx+png), routing diagram 1100x800 (svg). I'll add alt text layers.

Figma Bot: Frame "serve-wins-hero-v1" created by Noah (Design) at 2026-03-25T02:12:05Z.

Priya - Creative Ops: When assets are in, I'll run accessibility checks and prepare handoff zip (pngs, svgs, alt_text.md, export_manifest.csv). Name pattern: rdw_launchkit_<asset>_<audience>_v1.

Asha - MKTG: Please ping #marketing-ops when first pass is ready. Rehearsal Wed morning; need the slide PNG before then. Thanks! :raised_hands:

Noah (Design): Aiming to push hero + routing tonight. Will tag when ready. :paintbrush:
